description: Shrink a PDF from freedailypro the gentle way (the site's Balanced mode): tidy the file, empty blank pages, and re-save the pictures inside at about 140 dpi. Text stays selectable; links, bookmarks, form fields and page sizes are kept. Returns the smaller file plus the levels applied. Errors if the PDF is unreadable, password-protected, over 100 pages, or if nothing gets smaller (for example a PDF that is already mostly text); in that case try pdf_compress_aggressive.

fileBase64.description: The PDF, base64 encoded (up to 20 MB, up to 100 pages)

name: pdf_compress_balanced
